scope: All eleven existing articles; regulatory and material numerical assertions reviewed. Qualified editorial process guidance is not represented as a legal determination.

claims.claim: Type 41 / Type 47 privileges and eating-place requirement
claims.decision: Retained the beer/wine versus general alcohol distinction with food-service context; approval remains license- and premises-specific.

claims.claim: ABC approval versus local land-use authorization
claims.decision: Separated state licensing from local requirements; City of LA RBP eligibility is not a countywide rule or an automatic substitute for every approval.

claims.claim: Temporary permit and continuing alcohol operation
claims.decision: Explained the discretionary, qualifying person-to-person route; removed automatic operation, near-universal availability and one-week expectations. No numeric permit duration is asserted.

claims.claim: ABC application and escrow coordination
claims.decision: Linked official forms/process and escrow instructions; explained approval-dependent closing rather than a guaranteed timetable.

claims.claim: Health change of ownership versus construction review
claims.decision: Distinguished ownership change from proposed remodeling or equipment/layout changes; prior use does not establish permission for a new operation.

claims.claim: Health jurisdiction
claims.decision: Identifies Pasadena, Long Beach and Vernon as outside the described LA County program; route the project to its actual authority.

claims.claim: ADA and grandfathering
claims.decision: Removed blanket immunity assumptions; existing facilities can have ongoing readily achievable barrier-removal obligations.

claims.claim: Landlord consent and lease transfer
claims.decision: Explains the specific no-stated-standard case in Civil Code 1995.260. Actual lease language, facts and counsel determine application; no guaranteed approval.

claims.claim: Guarantor release, options and rent abatement
claims.decision: Treat release, option transfer and rent relief as document-dependent negotiated terms; preserve capped, burn-off, surrender and full-guaranty distinctions without a legal guarantee.

claims.claim: Beverly Hills city-specific process
claims.decision: Uses city zoning, business certificate and open-air dining resources; keeps local approvals separate from ABC.

claims.claim: SDE and valuation methods
claims.decision: Explains earnings adjustments with supporting records and replacement labor. IBBA supports the definition, not an LA market multiple; SBA supports multiple valuation approaches.

claims.claim: Universal 1.5–3× SDE and 3–6 month valuation validity
claims.decision: Replaced formula claims with evidence, valuation date, business/asset structure and risk factors.

claims.claim: Fixed transaction, diligence, landlord and licensing timelines
claims.decision: Removed 2–4 weeks, 21–45 days, 60–90 / 60–120 days, 4–9 months and 2–8 week expectations as universal claims. Explain dependencies and contractual dates.

claims.claim: Acquisition prices, minimum capital and financing percentages
claims.decision: Removed generalized $150,000–$2M+ acquisition prices, capital percentages, seller-carry proportions and canned SBA loan amount/term assumptions; use actual budget and lender terms.

claims.claim: Assignment fees and alcohol license premiums
claims.decision: Removed $1,000–$5,000 assignment-fee averages and fixed licensing premiums. Use lease-specific costs and the current official ABC fee schedule.

claims.claim: Six-figure savings and universal build-out cost advantage
claims.decision: Retained a qualitative potential advantage and added complete scope, condition and approvals comparison.

claims.claim: Rent ranges, neighborhood demand rankings and sale-value loss percentages
claims.decision: Removed unsourced $8–$18/sq ft/month local rent, premium/demand rankings and 20–40% value-loss assertions. Neighborhoods and corridors remain illustrative evaluation settings.

claims.claim: 24 months of financial records; reserve and training periods
claims.decision: Two years can be a preparation starting point rather than a universal requirement. Reserve size and transition scope depend on the actual business and agreement, not a universal 90-day or 1–4-week rule.

claims.claim: Illustrative $100,000 earnings less $20,000 cost equals $80,000
claims.decision: Explicitly hypothetical arithmetic that explains sensitivity; not a reported transaction, market average or valuation estimate.

claims.claim: Offer, tax, staffing, confidentiality and applicant eligibility
claims.decision: Removed automatic legal outcomes, absolute confidentiality and blanket disclosure/eligibility directions; scope review to transaction documents and appropriate professionals.

claims.claim: Fresh rent, demand, transaction multiples, ranking and traffic evidence
claims.decision: No unsupported substitute figures published. Future dated market reporting requires reliable data and defined coverage; Search Console/backlinks are unavailable.

sources.title: ABC temporary permit
sources.application: Conditional, discretionary same-premises person-to-person route; not a blanket permission for new licenses or relocation.

sources.title: ABC transfer application
sources.application: Required documents and temporary permit application are separate steps.

sources.title: ABC escrow
sources.application: Escrow approval condition; avoid substituting a generic closing timeline.

sources.title: California Civil Code 1995.260
sources.application: Implied reasonable-consent standard applies to the described lease restriction; not a guarantee every assignment is approved.

sources.title: DOJ ADA small-business primer
sources.application: Existing facilities can have ongoing readily achievable barrier-removal duties. Do not claim blanket grandfather immunity.

sources.title: Beverly Hills commercial regulations
sources.application: Address zoning, business tax certificate and open-air dining requirements; no support for current rent or demand rankings.

sources.title: SBA business purchase planning
sources.application: Supports evaluating multiple valuation approaches, not a universal LA restaurant SDE multiple.

sources.title: ABC license types
sources.application: Phase 3 source review: distinguish Type 41/47 privileges and eating-place requirement.

sources.title: LA City RBP
sources.application: Phase 3 source review: eligible restaurants may use administrative RBP route instead of CUB; do not apply City rules countywide.

sources.title: LA County restaurant permits
sources.application: Phase 3 source review: purchase without major changes differs from construction/remodel plan check.

sources.title: LA County plan-check service area
sources.application: Phase 3 source review: Long Beach, Pasadena, Vernon exclusions.

sources.title: IBBA: SDE definition
sources.application: Primary professional association explanation of adjusted earnings and replacement-salary distinction; used only for the SDE concept, not 2026 market multiples.
